sso.divider: or sign in with a password

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Use your admin account to manage this server.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.description: Use the recovery token from the panel host to choose a new admin password.
recovery.tokenHelp: Stored at data/reset-token.txt on the panel host.
recovery.codeHelp: One of the recovery codes you saved from Settings → Security. Each code works once.

lostPassword.helpLocal: This browser is running on the panel host. Create a recovery file, then use its token to reset the admin password.
lostPassword.helpRemote1: Create data/reset-token.txt on the panel host with any token at least 8 characters long.
lostPassword.helpRemote2: You can also start the panel with --reset-password from the server terminal.

resetTokenCreated: Recovery token created at data/reset-token.txt. Paste it below to continue.

repeatedFailureHint.title: Still not working?
repeatedFailureHint.body: After several failed attempts, an account locks automatically for 15 minutes as a security precaution -- this screen will not say so. A saved recovery code, or starting the panel with --reset-password from the server terminal, can reset the password without waiting.

errors.resetTokenTooShort: Reset token must be at least 8 characters
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
errors.noRecoveryTokenYet: No recovery token found yet. Create data/reset-token.txt on the panel host, then try again.
errors.couldNotCheckStatus: Could not check recovery status. Try again in a moment.
errors.couldNotCreateToken: Could not create a recovery token

oidc.not_configured: Single sign-on isn't available right now. Sign in with your username and password.
oidc.expired_flow: Your sign-in attempt expired. Try again.
oidc.invalid_token: The identity provider's response couldn't be verified. Try again, or sign in with your username and password.
oidc.session_failed: Something went wrong finishing sign-in. Try again, or sign in with your username and password.
oidc.refused: That account isn't permitted to sign in this way. Sign in with your username and password, or contact your administrator.
oidc.setup_required: No admin account exists yet. Complete first-run setup with a username and password, then link single sign-on from Settings.
oidc.generic: Single sign-on couldn't be completed. Try again, or sign in with your username and password.
